What works today

Pilot briefs and success targets; matched time and rework observations; paired quality checks; exclusions with reasons; an editable capacity-value scenario; CSV and JSON exports; and a standalone HTML readout with a print-to-PDF option. Data is saved locally in one browser.

The calculation pools total minutes and divides by matched unit count. It displays observed differences, including negative results. Quality is assessed separately. Modeled staff-time value is labeled as an assumption, not as cash savings.

Clear boundaries, useful evidence

This is an early tool for one coordinator. It has no shared database, accounts, independent verification, immutable audit trail, electronic signatures, or statistical inference. User-entered comparisons cannot by themselves establish causation. A favorable sample does not guarantee future performance.

Records stay in browser local storage until you export them. Anyone with access to that browser profile may see them; clearing browser storage removes them. Keep backups and use non-sensitive project labels. No app analytics or tracking cookies are included. Google Fonts may receive font requests, and the hosting provider receives ordinary web requests.

Public source is available for evaluation. Publication does not grant a production, redistribution, or white-label license. Contact Tom to discuss commercial terms.
